results.question: 看看深振业A2022年的营业收入
results.sql:
SELECT i.ts_code, s.name AS stock_name, i.end_date, i.revenue
FROM fin.income i
JOIN stock.stock_basic s ON i.ts_code = s.ts_code
LEFT JOIN fin.fina_indicator f
    ON i.ts_code = f.ts_code AND i.end_date = f.end_date AND i.report_type = f.report_type
LEFT JOIN fin.balancesheet b
    ON i.ts_code = b.ts_code AND i.end_date = b.end_date AND i.report_type = b.report_type
LEFT JOIN fin.cashflow c
    ON i.ts_code = c.ts_code AND i.end_date = c.end_date AND i.report_type = c.report_type
WHERE i.ts_code = '000006.SZ' AND i.report_type = '1' AND i.end_date = '2022-12-31'
ORDER BY i.end_date DESC
LIMIT 12
results.response:
查询结果:
  深振业A 2022-12-31: stock_name: 深振业A | end_date: 2022-12-31 | revenue: 3699813551.4100

SELECT i.ts_code, s.name AS stock_name, i.end_date, f.debt_to_assets
FROM fin.income i
JOIN stock.stock_basic s ON i.ts_code = s.ts_code
LEFT JOIN fin.fina_indicator f
    ON i.ts_code = f.ts_code AND i.end_date = f.end_date AND i.report_type = f.report_type
LEFT JOIN fin.balancesheet b
    ON i.ts_code = b.ts_code AND i.end_date = b.end_date AND i.report_type = b.report_type
LEFT JOIN fin.cashflow c
    ON i.ts_code = c.ts_code AND i.end_date = c.end_date AND i.report_type = c.report_type
WHERE i.ts_code = '000001.SZ' AND i.report_type = '1'
ORDER BY i.end_date DESC
LIMIT 12

SELECT s.name, d.trade_date, d.close, d.pct_chg, db.pe_ttm, db.total_mv
FROM stock.daily d
JOIN stock.stock_basic s ON d.ts_code = s.ts_code
LEFT JOIN stock.daily_basic db
    ON d.trade_date = db.trade_date AND d.ts_code = db.ts_code
WHERE d.ts_code IN ('000006.SZ', '000858.SZ')
  AND d.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM stock.daily)
ORDER BY d.close DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT i.ts_code, s.name AS stock_name, i.end_date, i.operate_profit
FROM fin.income i
JOIN stock.stock_basic s ON i.ts_code = s.ts_code
LEFT JOIN fin.fina_indicator f
    ON i.ts_code = f.ts_code AND i.end_date = f.end_date AND i.report_type = f.report_type
LEFT JOIN fin.balancesheet b
    ON i.ts_code = b.ts_code AND i.end_date = b.end_date AND i.report_type = b.report_type
LEFT JOIN fin.cashflow c
    ON i.ts_code = c.ts_code AND i.end_date = c.end_date AND i.report_type = c.report_type
WHERE i.ts_code = '000001.SZ' AND i.report_type = '1'
ORDER BY i.end_date DESC
LIMIT 12
